slate_notes: Pregame, Nov 19 (week 2 day 1). There was no 2026-11-19-morning run, so there were no morning legs to recheck or swap. Nothing was pending to grade (all runs through 11-18-pregame are graded). Six new legs under P2, all priced 4:45-4:47 PM ET today (after 3:00 PM) at 4-5 books, per-book devig median: NFL TNF x1 (IND @ HOU), NBA x4 (one per game: LAC@SAS, GSW@MEM, POR@MIL, NYK@MIN), NHL x1 (DAL@VGK). All overs, so no under shading applies. One leg per game, no shared game thesis. None of these player+prop pairs had a miss in the last 3 days. Passed despite good prices because recent logs disagreed: Dosunmu O3.5 ast (4/10), Wells O2.5 reb, Cissoko O1.5 ast, Herro O3.5 reb, Fox O3.5 reb, Brunson O2.5 reb, Deion Burks O1.5 rec (1/10, unexplained role change). Also passed on Boutte U2.5 rec (beyond -180 and shares the HOU target thesis with Collins). Confirm every line in the app (the public boards are blocked from the box); skip any Goblin/Demon versions.
